title: Pre-registered RSM and native token-level ReSkip sensitivity analysis
claim_order: RSM improves or preserves the ordinary Full-path AttnRes adaptation objective.
RSM learns functionally meaningful token- and block-dependent residual strength rather than a static skip controller.
A frozen native token-level ReSkip policy exposes a quality-compute Pareto frontier as an inference-time by-product.

experiment_1_gate_scale.purpose: Full-path residual calibration sensitivity; not policy selection.
experiment_1_gate_scale.evaluation: official six-task lmms-eval macro: AI2D, MMBench, MMMU, MMStar, OCRBench, RealWorldQA
experiment_1_gate_scale.selection_rule: The accepted main configuration remains gate_scale=0.5 regardless of the sweep outcome.

experiment_2_block_token.purpose: Mechanistic and causal analysis of the accepted Full-path checkpoints.

experiment_3_pareto.purpose: Inference-only sensitivity to a frozen calibration coverage knob.
experiment_3_pareto.calibration_source: the existing seed-259123 heldout teacher-forcing rows only
experiment_3_pareto.quality_metric: official six-task macro and per-task deltas relative to Full RSM
experiment_3_pareto.compute_metric: observed removed block-equivalents per decode token
experiment_3_pareto.runtime_metric: fixed-64 paired end-to-end speedup; natural generation remains reported only for the accepted operating point
experiment_3_pareto.stopping_rule: Evaluate the four frozen coverage levels only; do not insert intermediate levels after observing quality.

post_result_rule: Failures remain in the sensitivity table and figure. No model, seed, gate scale, coverage level, or task may be silently removed because of its outcome.
